title: 遊泰染流感 嬤進加護花60萬才回台

tags.speaker: media
tags.storyline: Unvaccinated elderly flu case after Thailand trip
tags.title_en: Grandmother catches flu in Thailand, ICU for 600,000 before returning to Taiwan
tags.summary_en: The outlet reports that an elderly woman caught flu in Thailand and was treated in intensive care costing about NT$600,000 before she returned to Taiwan; the article also mentions enhanced influenza vaccines.
tags.summary_zh: 報導指出一名長者在泰國感染流感，於加護病房治療花費約60萬元新台幣，之後才返回台灣；文中並提及加強型流感疫苗。
